info.name: Sonatype Lifecycle Public REST Advanced Search Policy Waiver Requests API

params.name: ownerType
params.description: The scope of the policy waiver request. Possible values are application, organization, repository, repository_manager, repository_container.

params.name: ownerId
params.description: The id for the ownerType provided above. E.g. applicationId if the ownerType is application.

params.name: policyViolationId
params.description: The policyViolationId for the policy violation on which you want to create a policy waiver request. Use the Policy Violation REST API or Reports REST API to obtain the policyViolationId.

items.docs:
